name: zombie-dismembered
notes: D-42 with the game's partsLost: what's left of a body reacts. Left to right from the camera (+X): a shambler whose left leg is shot off at 0.5 s (it goes over, lies, and gets up on the leg it has); one whose right arm goes at 0.4 s and that takes a rifle round at 0.9 s (it only rocks); one whose head goes at 0.5 s with the killing shot (it drops limp).
